bias.zh: 反弹 · 收复 $186–189，重回 5 日均线上方

read.en: Bloom Energy rose 11.9% on Nov 9 to $193.88, trading $180.50–199.83. It closed above the falling 5-day average ($189.8) but below the falling 10-day ($201.7), 30-day ($236.8) and 100-day ($241.2) and the rising 200-day ($222.7). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 8 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 4 ($224.97), and RSI is 43.
read.zh: Bloom Energy 11月9日上涨 11.9%，收于 $193.88，盘中区间 $180.50–199.83。股价收于下行的 5 日均线（$189.8）上方，但仍低于下行的 10 日（$201.7）、30 日（$236.8）和 100 日均线（$241.2），以及上行的 200 日均线（$222.7）。MACD 自 10月8日起位于信号线下方且在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月4日起看空（$224.97），RSI 为 43。

read.en: The rally broke the $185.9–189 resistance (Aug 24 and Oct 23 lows) and the 5-day, now support, but the $199.83 high faded. Resistance is $194.2–199.8 (Oct 30 and Nov 2 lows, Nov 9 high), then $201.7–203.2 (10-day, Oct 30 close) and $222.7–225 (200-day, SAR). Support is $185.9–189.8, then $180.5 and $168.8. A close above $199.8 would target $201.7–203.2; below $185.9, $180.5.

r.en: Oct 30 and Nov 2 lows ($194.2–194.9); Nov 9 high $199.83

s.en: Aug 24 low $185.9; Oct 23 low $189, reclaimed; 5-day average $189.8
